title: Revisiting the p53:Sirt1 interaction in light of controlling p53 acetylation levels.
authors: Pandey, Vishnupriya; Hause, Frank; Iacobucci, Claudio; Ihling, Christian H; Tueting, Christian; Kastritis, Panagiotis L; Arlt, Christian; Sinz, Andrea
one_liner_zh: 该文通过质谱与数据驱动分子对接构建全长p53:Sirt1复合物结构模型，虽涉及p53蛋白-DNA结合域但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作，非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: The NAD(+)-dependent deacetylase sirtuin 1 (Sirt1) is known to regulate the tumor suppressor p53 via deacetylation, but the structural basis of the protein-protein interaction between full-length p53 and Sirt1 has so far remained elusive. We apply an integrated approach, combining structural mass spectrometry (MS) with data-driven molecular docking, to study the interaction between human p53 and Sirt1. Sirt1 was found to bind exclusively to acetylated p53 forming complexes with a 1:1 stoichiometry, irrespectively of p53's oligomeric state. The lysine residue at position 382 (K382) in p53 was identified as predominant acetylation site showing a selective Sirt1-dependent deacetylation at this position. Cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) provided valuable distance constraints between p53 and Sirt1. Specifically, cross-links created between p53-K382 / Sirt1-K427 and p53-K120 / Sirt1-K622 give hints on a highly flexible interface. Molecular docking was conducted based on the distance constraints imposed by the cross-links, positioning Sirt1 at the DNA-binding and tetramerization domains of p53. This gives a rationale for a steric exclusion of additional Sirt1 molecules binding to p53. We present the first structural model of the full-length p53:Sirt1 (1:1) complex, establishing a mechanistic framework that links p53 activity to its Sirt1-controlled acetylation status.
abstract_zh: 已知NAD(+)-依赖性去乙酰化酶sirtuin 1（Sirt1）通过去乙酰化调控肿瘤抑制因子p53，但全长p53与Sirt1之间蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的结构基础至今仍不明确。我们采用一种整合方法，结合结构质谱（structural mass spectrometry, MS）与数据驱动的分子对接（molecular docking），研究人p53与Sirt1之间的相互作用。研究发现，Sirt1仅与乙酰化p53结合，形成1:1化学计量的复合物，且与p53的寡聚状态无关。p53中第382位赖氨酸残基（K382）被鉴定为主要乙酰化位点，并在此位置表现出选择性的Sirt1依赖性去乙酰化。交联质谱（cross-linking mass spectrometry, XL-MS）提供了p53与Sirt1之间有价值的距离约束。具体而言，p53-K382 / Sirt1-K427和p53-K120 / Sirt1-K622之间形成的交联提示了一个高度灵活的界面。基于交联施加的距离约束进行分子对接，将Sirt1定位在p53的DNA结合域和四聚化域。这为额外Sirt1分子结合p53的空间排斥提供了合理解释。我们提出了全长p53:Sirt1（1:1）复合物的首个结构模型，建立了一个将p53活性与其Sirt1控制的乙酰化状态联系起来的机制框架。
